title: ImageNet's secret ingredient was labelled data at scale
body: Fei-Fei Li's ImageNet put over fourteen million human-labelled images behind a benchmark, arguing the field was modelling-rich and data-poor. Label quality was farmed through Mechanical Turk with elaborate verification. The dataset, more than any single algorithm, made 2012 possible; deep learning's fuel turned out to be annotation labour organised cleverly.
